about: Buses and trams: each operator's own site, feed or open API first; the press only where the operator publishes nothing readable (those are the researcher's decisions, linked). Short excerpts with the link.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No advice of ours. Your airline or operator decides whether your flight or service runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.
